k01.text: I searched the kitchen for a banana or apple, but my quest was fruitless.

k02.text: What's the worst way to tell someone to stop making forgeries? "Knock it off."

k03.text: My friend was a brilliant musician but an awful driver. He once drove off a clef after getting into a treble accident.

k04.text: So you know the state above Texas? Well, it's OK.

k05.text: Why did the chicken cross the Red Sea? Because he was making an eggs-odus.

k06.text: I'm addicted to buying hatchets from other countries because of their smell. I love foreign axe scents.

k07.text: Which animal has many questions? An askalotl.

k08.text: I almost never laugh at airplane jokes. They usually go right over my head.

k09.text: I used to work in a shoe recycling shop. It was sole destroying.

k10.text: How did Quasimodo know which bells to ring at Notre Dame? He just had a hunch.

k11.text: I was waiting to use the self checkout at the supermarket when I saw the guy in front of me turn to the woman next to him and ask if she would be his girlfriend, and to my surprise she said yes! They were an unexpected item in the bagging area.

k12.text: What did the drummer name his twin daughters? Anna One, Anna Two.

k13.text: My wife told me that quilts are better than duvets. I told her she should be careful making blanket statements.

k14.text: Did you hear about the mathematician who's afraid of negative numbers? He'll stop at nothing to avoid them.

k15.text: What do you call a citrus that likes to wander? A meanderin' orange.

k16.text: My uncle lost his left side in a motorcycle accident. He's all right now.

k17.text: I used to be addicted to the Hokey Pokey. But I turned myself around.

k18.text: Parallel lines have so much in common. It's a shame they'll never meet.

k19.text: I got eczema, diarrhoea, gonorrhoea, and haemorrhoids last week. First time I've ever won a game of Scrabble.

k20.text: I accidentally ripped the outfit I was going to wear to a Super Bowl party. I need a tailor, swift.

k21.text: I feel bad for Greek vegans. They never meat their gyros.

k22.text: What do you call a plumbing apprenticeship? Potty training.

k23.text: My neighbor stole my fence and won't give it back. I'm so tired of the gatekeeping.

k24.text: Did you know that the world's first time traveler was a Roman general? He could move centuries forward.

k25.text: How do you drown a hipster? Throw him in the mainstream.

k26.text: Where does a pirate buy his hooks? At the second hand store.

k27.text: I'm currently reading a book about a couple of insects who fall in love in an Italian city. It's a Rome ants novel.

k28.text: I filled my colander to let it soak. Unfortunately, I couldn't see the holes in my plan.

k29.text: If you've never tried blind target shooting, you don't know what you're missing.

k30.text: How did those felines get so rich? Catpitalism.

k31.text: Spaces between ladder rungs have increased because people are getting taller. Others claim it's due to climb it change.

k32.text: Criminals stole all the wheels off a cop car. Now the police are working tirelessly to find them.

k33.text: I'm worried about the calendar. It's days are numbered.

k34.text: Why does a singer's voice bounce off an auditorium's walls, but a pigeon's doesn't? A "coo" sticks.

k35.text: What do you get if you cross a dog with Penn & Teller? Two Labracadabradors.

k36.text: What happened to the robot that used its AC adapter to attack a person? It was charged with battery.

k37.text: Two antennas met on a roof, fell in love, and got married. The ceremony wasn't too special but the reception was incredible.

k38.text: I thought I won the argument with my wife about how to arrange our dining room furniture. But when I got home, the tables were turned.

k39.text: Somebody called me on my phone, sneezed twice, and then hung up. I'm getting sick and tired of these cold calls.

k40.text: I met a girl online and arranged a blind date with her at the gym, but she never showed up. That's when I knew we weren't going to work out.

k41.text: Parties with ghosts are always fun. They're so spook-tacular!

k42.text: This new jam I tried was so good it was shocking. It was made from electrical currants.

k43.text: What did the broken down car say when asked how he travels so much? "I only go where I'm towed."

k44.text: Is flying to Stockholm too expensive? Then let me Sweden the deal for you with a discount coupon.

k45.text: I dropped a bag of flour at the grocery store. I went to pick it up but the assistant said, "Don't bother, it's self-rising."

k46.text: What's green and likes to insult people? A provocado.

k47.text: What do you call a crocodile who found a treasure? Crockpot.

k48.text: I can't afford to play tennis anymore. I know the old saying "please tip your server," but it's costing me $50 in tips each game!

k49.text: Why did the hungry rowboat captain reach for his spyglass? He thought he spotted a meaty oar.

k50.text: I was annoyed when my wife gave me a coffin for my birthday. I said, "This is the last thing that I need."

k51.text: I can't decide which suit accessory to wear. It's a tie.

k52.text: What do you call a sassy floating fire? Flamebuoyant.

k53.text: To whoever stole my place in line at the grocery store: I'm after you now.

k54.text: I bought a pencil with two erasers. It was pointless.

k55.text: Why are chickens so annoying sometimes? Because they're really cocky.

k56.text: Justice is a dish best served cold. Otherwise, it's just water.

k57.text: I can't stop thinking about cysts, blisters, and boils. I'm abscessed!

k58.text: If you're dating someone who doesn't like Star Wars puns, you're looking for love in Alderaan places.

k59.text: Why do cows have hooves? Because they lactose.

k60.text: I'm having difficulty trying to sell my puppet collection. I need someone to take them off my hands.

k61.text: Public Enemy's Chuck D has retired from music and is now pursuing a career in standup comedy, as Chuck L.

k62.text: I save my back exercise for the end: lats but not least.

k63.text: I paid a guy to map out a jogging route for me. He's giving me a run for my money.

k64.text: I used to be addicted to soap. I'm clean now.

k65.text: After every catastrophic event, you can always find a man doing calculations. He is working in the aftermath.

k66.text: Is my wife mad at me? She's been making me sandwiches with deli sliced beef chuck. I think she's giving me the cold shoulder.

k67.text: There's this guy who used to be famous for taking showers in front of massive audiences. He's all washed up now.

k68.text: Sundays are always a little sad. But the day before is a sadder day.

k69.text: I made the mistake of living with my grammar teacher for the last seven years. Now we're married by comma law.

k70.text: What kind of party do you throw for a mare who's getting married? A bridle shower.

k71.text: Why do dogs float in water? Because they're good buoys.

k72.text: I think I might start a business where I sell records of grunge music. I think I'll call it Nirvinyl.
